Cost: 1,500eb (V. Expensive) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

A derivative of existing cyberlimb-based ordinance launchers, this awkward clunk of metal is what happens when a boom-happy junkie with a cybertech degree isn’t satisfied with a single dose per arm.

Cyberarm. Borgware. Has 1 Option Slot for Cyberhand Options only. Comes pre-installed with a Projectile Launch System (PLS) that doesn’t cause Humanity Loss or consume an Option Slot, and is equipped with a non-removable Drum Magazine which increases its Capacity to 6. If this Cyberarm’s PLS was fired in the previous Round of combat, it cannot be fired as its slow-cycling autoloader requires the entire Round to load the next shot. After this Cyberarm’s PLS is drawn, it requires an Action to be stowed.

Requires BODY 9+ for this Cyberarm to not reduce MOVE by 1 and incur a -1 penalty to all Checks that involve it or any of its installed options, including weapons. This Cyberarm is always distinguishable as a Cyberarm, even while covered with RealskinnTM.

Type: Cyberarm (Foundational)
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 0, provides 1

Foundry notes:

  • The pre-installed PLS is described here rather than installed as a separate item. Cyberpunk RED - Core 0.92.4 has no Projectile Launch System item; use its Popup Grenade Launcher if you want one on the sheet.
  • The sheet won't restrict the Option Slot to Cyberhand Options, and the BODY 9 penalty is applied by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).
